headlines.description: — Elly De La Cruz homered, scored three times and drove in three runs as the Cincinnati Reds rallied to beat the Detroit Tigers 8-4 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Elly De La Cruz has 3 RBIs, scores 3 runs as Reds rally to beat Tigers 8-4

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Gary Sánchez hit a seventh-inning grand slam, Ramón Urías and Jordan Westburg also homered, and the Baltimore Orioles completed a three-game sweep with a 11-2 victory Sunday over the Los Angeles Angels.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gary Sánchez hits a grand slam and the Orioles complete sweep of Angels with 11-2 rout

headlines.description: — Ryan McMahon hit a go-ahead home run in the seventh and the Colorado Rockies overcame Grant Holmes' 15-strikeout performance to beat the Atlanta Braves 10-1 on Sunday and avoid a series sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: McMahon hits go-ahead homer in 7th as Rockies beat Holmes and Braves 10-1

headlines.description: — Eric Wagaman had two RBI, Dane Meyers hit a solo home run and the Miami Marlins beat the Washington Nationals 3-1 on Sunday to sweep a three-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wagaman's 2 RBIs, Meyers' solo HR help Marlins sweep Nationals with 3-1 victory

events.name: New York Yankees at Boston Red Sox
Toronto Blue Jays at Philadelphia Phillies

headlines.description: — Nick Castellanos hit a grand slam, Zack Wheeler pitched six strong innings and the Philadelphia Phillies completed a three-game sweep of the Toronto Blue Jays with an 11-4 victory on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Castellanos hits a grand slam and Phillies complete 3-game sweep of Blue Jays with 11-4 win

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Shane Baz combined with three relievers on a five-hitter, and the Tampa Bay Rays beat New York 9-0 on Sunday to complete the first three-game series sweep of the Mets this season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Baz combines on 5-hitter, leads Rays to 9-0 win for first 3-game series sweep of Mets this season

headlines.description: — Victor Caratini tied it with a sacrifice fly in the ninth and Mauricio Dubón hit a walk-off single in the 10th on Sunday to help the Astros beat the Minnesota Twins 2-1 to sweep the three-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mauricio Dubón's walk-off single lifts Astros over Twins 2-1, sweep 3-game series

events.name: Athletics Athletics at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Nick Kurtz hit a solo ninth-inning homer to rally the Athletics to a 3-2 win and three-game sweep of the Kansas City Royals on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nick Kurtz hits a solo homer to rally the Athletics to a 3-2 win and sweep of the Royals

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Milwaukee Brewers

headlines.description: — Christian Yelich homered and Trevor Megill escaped a jam in the ninth inning, sending the Milwaukee Brewers to a 3-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals on Sunday in the finale of a four-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yelich homers and Megill escapes a 9th-inning jam as the Brewers top the Cardinals 3-2

headlines.description: — Ian Happ hit a game-ending single in the 10th inning, and the Chicago Cubs edged the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-2 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Happ hits a game-ending single in the 10th as the Cubs top the Pirates 3-2

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Rookie right-hander Kumar Rocker pitched five scoreless innings with help from some pickle juice, Ezequiel Duran put Texas in front for...
headlines.shortLinkText: Kumar Rocker gets assist from pickle juice in win as Rangers top White Sox 2-1

headlines.description: — J.P. Crawford hit a grand slam, Emerson Hancock tossed seven scoreless innings and the Seattle Mariners beat the Cleveland Guardians 6-0 on Sunday to complete a sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Crawford hits a grand slam, Hancock tosses 7 scoreless and the Mariners beat the Guardians 6-0

events.name: San Diego Padres at Arizona Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Nick Pivetta held Arizona to two hits over seven innings and Jake Cronenworth homered as the San Diego Padres defeated the Diamondbacks 8-2 on Sunday to snap a three-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Padres beat Diamondbacks 8-2 to snap 3-game losing streak

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Andy Pages hit a game-turning three-run home run in the fifth inning, Shohei Ohtani had three hits and scored two runs, and the Los Angeles Dodgers beat the San Francisco Giants 5-4 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Andy Pages' 3-run homer pushes Dodgers to 5-4 win over Giants
